headline: Japanese Yen Rockets Against US Dollar Amid Suspected Tokyo Market Intervention
summary: The Japanese yen surged against the US dollar, likely due to unannounced intervention by Tokyo authorities, marking its largest one-day gain since 2022 on high trading volumes.
why: Currency intervention by Japan's authorities directly moves the yen, affecting exporters' earnings, import costs and carry-trade positioning.

impacts.name: Japanese yen
impacts.why: Suspected official intervention pushed the yen sharply higher against the dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The yen's largest one-day gain since 2022 is likely the result of unannounced intervention by Tokyo authorities, with high trading volumes amplifying the move.
